name: Iron
notes: Wrought and cast iron: gates, grates, chains, rails, armour. Conducts charge and never burns. Density 7870 kg/m³ (pure iron). The toughest common material (800 hp). Friction 0.4 is dry iron on leather. Rings rather than absorbs sound (0.02). Loud underfoot (+6 dB, audio bible §7.3: metal-grate is loud). Smooth bars are a sheer climb that needs a tool. Hard surface: arrows ricochet and rope arrows do not embed. (mw-e03.31) Barely absorbs water: wetness caps at its absorbency (mw-e03.6).
